stem: A room-level VPD chart based on air temperature appears acceptable, but measured leaf temperature is meaningfully lower than the air temperature. What is the best next interpretation step?
choices: Verify which temperature basis the VPD method uses and recalculate consistently before changing the environment
Assume the air-temperature chart is exact for the leaf surface and make an immediate large humidity change
Ignore temperature because relative humidity alone determines VPD
Change nutrient concentration because VPD is controlled primarily by root-zone EC
rationale: Air-temperature and leaf-temperature approaches are not interchangeable. The learner should confirm the calculation method and measurement basis before making an environmental correction.
